title: Murray P NDE 15
content: I was in a motorcycle accident on August 10, 1986, on a highway between Kamloops, British Columbia, and Merritt, British Columbia. I failed to negotiate a turn and crashed into the side of a mountain at approximately 119 miles per hour. It was above 90ºF. at the time. It occurred at 4:00 P.M. In the ambulance, just before passing out, I heard one attendant say, 'You better step on it! I don't think he's going to make it.' I felt like I was experiencing a respiratory arrest at that time. Then I must have passed out. I felt a floating in a darkness. A white light appeared to approach. As it neared, it became more intense and whiter. Then I was inside the light. It reminded me of a Swedish globe only much, much brighter, almost too bright to see and yet, it wasn't hurtful or unpleasant. On the contrary, I had the feeling of an intense love and acceptance and that everything would be all right. Next, I heard a very deep, majestic male voice ask, 'What have you done with your life?' I saw my life as a panorama while being able to see it in its entirety simultaneously. I didn't feel too good with what I saw. The voice, once again asked, 'What have you done with your life?' This time it sounded more stern and angry. All I could say was, 'Nothing.' At that point, I was no longer in the light, but rather I was floating in an upright position over a gently hilly landscape. I was barefoot and I could feel the short soft velvety grass brush the bottoms of my feet. It was very soothing. The grass was black and felt like velvet. The sky was a beautiful orange color and I could see the silhouette of trees against the sky. I came to a small log bridge with two small knolls. On my side was a man dressed in a dark suit (contemporary dress) and on the other side of the bridge was a man dressed in a white full length robe. He had long flowing silver hair that extended to the upper part of his back. He held a staff in his left hand and held up his right hand motioning for me to stop. He said, 'Go no further, you have much to do.' I knew that either I could choose to return to my body or I could cross the bridge. I knew, though, that it would be a mistake to cross the bridge. When I realized this, I felt myself falling (sliding) through a multi-colored tunnel that was spinning around me as I descended. I saw myself about ten feet above my body, my friend was holding my head, and saying, 'Come on back buddy, we can't lose you now.' I then regained consciousness in my body.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Felt a floating in a darkness; later fell (slid) through a multi-colored tunnel that was spinning around me as I descended.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Sliding/falling downward; tunnel spinning around him while descending.

arrival.other_being_detail: Two men at a small log bridge: one in a dark contemporary suit; one in a white full-length robe with long flowing silver hair and a staff; the robed man raised his hand to stop him and spoke.

environment.environment_other_detail: Gently hilly landscape; short soft velvety black grass; beautiful orange sky; silhouettes of trees; small log bridge with two knolls.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt himself falling/sliding through a spinning multi-colored tunnel, then saw himself about ten feet above his body and regained consciousness in his body.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told: 'Go no further, you have much to do.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Motorcycle accident; crashed into the side of a mountain at approximately 119 miles per hour.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Darkness/floating and approaching white light; inside the light with a questioning voice and panoramic life review; then landscape/bridge boundary with beings; then a spinning multi-colored tunnel during return; then OBE view above body and return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Black velvety grass felt under bare feet; stern/angry repeated question by a deep majestic male voice; two figures at a log bridge (one in dark suit, one in white robe with silver hair and staff).
